decision.rationale: The candidate enforces the requested no-Claude boundary, pins the feasible local model, controls optional OpenRouter routes, and preserves every qualified deployment and recovery behavior.
limitations: Identity, routing controls, and local installation are verified, but Qwen3.5 9B and Mistral answer quality are not evaluated or selected.
Direct DeepSeek remains selected; OpenRouter and BYOK have not been configured or called.
The deployment run used synthetic data, localhost, and one development host.
Public DNS, trusted certificate issuance, target-host restore, professor-fidelity calibration, real-course multimodal quality, factual-QA scale quality, and human usability remain pending.
